tasks.title: The first line
tasks.statement: Write a program that prints exactly one line: «Привет, Python!» (without the guillemets).
tasks.hint: One print command, with the text in quotes inside the parentheses.

tasks.title: Two lines
tasks.statement: Print two lines one after another: first «Меня зовут Python», then «Мне 34 года» (without the guillemets).
tasks.hint: Each line is its own print command; they run from top to bottom.

tasks.title: Print can calculate
tasks.statement: Print the result of multiplying six by seven, but calculate it inside print itself, rather than writing a ready number in quotes.
tasks.hint: You can write arithmetic inside the parentheses of print: print(6 * 7).

tasks.title: Repeating a string
tasks.statement: Print «ляляля», but get this string by multiplying the string «ля» by three, rather than typing the ready word.

tasks.title: Repeating for real
tasks.statement: Print the string i234_34$ exactly 344 times in a row, as one line, with no spaces or line breaks. Do it by multiplying a string by a number: nobody could retype that by hand.
tasks.hint: print('i234_34$' * 344): the asterisk repeats the string the needed number of times.
